svg.title: Client round-trip latency by decision path
svg.desc: No token: median 17.3 ms, p95 18.7; Forged token: median 28.8 ms, p95 30.5; Unmapped route: median 38.5 ms, p95 55.1; Cross-tenant: median 44.2 ms, p95 69.7; Cedar forbid (P2): median 45.9 ms, p95 176.6; ALLOW: median 62 ms, p95 178.3
svg.text: Client round-trip latency by decision path
Each dot is one request. Box: interquartile range; line: p5–p95; dark tick: median.
ms (dots beyond 200 ms are drawn at the edge)
Client round-trip = network + API Gateway + Lambda PEP (+ target on ALLOW). Source: latency-<run>-client.csv. Total
